Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 11  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that "Diary of a Maniac (1993) has the director born later than Return of the Hero (Le Retour du héros, 2018)." This is a clear error in interpretation, as the data gathered shows that Marco Ferreri (Diary of a Maniac) was born in 1928, while Laurent Tirard (Return of the Hero) was born in 1967. Laurent Tirard was born later, making "Return of the Hero" the correct answer. The Planner's misinterpretation of the data directly led to the incorrect solution to the problem.
